summary: Each session gets its own rail and tools column, every page shares one header, and comments, repositories and titles each take one click.

new.title: A session rail beside the page
new.copy: The sidebar always shows the workspace: New session, the doors, Pinned and Sessions.

new.title: Session tools in one column
new.copy: Ask, Terminal, Explore, Context and Scripts sit as icons in a thin column at the right of the session, the same on every page and rail level.

new.title: Repository status in the top bar
new.copy: A Repositories entry beside the workspace switcher says which repos have something to pull, such as 3 behind or Diverged.

new.title: Orchestrated runs on their own page
new.copy: Orchestrated runs have their own page after Runs.

new.title: Four ways to start a session
new.copy: New session asks how you want to start: Pick up a task, Run a workflow, Orchestrate or Ask an agent.

new.title: Auto agents page
new.copy: Auto has its own page beside Agents, marked Experimental, and no longer needs a switch in Settings.

features.title: Welcome to Goodboy
features.copy: Five short steps take you from install to a first agent reading your project: Provider, Project, Code host, Tasks and First session.

features.title: Provider connection
features.copy: Connect the provider you already pay for, with a login or an API key.

features.title: One page per provider
features.copy: Each provider has its own page in Providers & models with its usage, the models shown in the picker, its permissions and your account.

features.title: Update the provider CLI
features.copy: When a model needs a newer provider CLI, the provider page says so and one button installs it.

features.title: Permissions for each provider
features.copy: See which permission modes a provider can honor before you pick one, from Read only to Full access.

features.title: Integrations
features.copy: Connect GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Linear, Jira, Sentry and Slack from one page, and see the account behind each.

features.title: About you
features.copy: Tell agents once who you are and how you like to work, in four short fields.

features.title: Settings
features.copy: Settings opens from the foot of the sidebar or with ⌘,, on the page you used last.

features.title: How do you want to start?
features.copy: The New session draft has one compact selector with four choices: Pick up a task, Run a workflow, Orchestrate and Ask an agent, and a line under it that says what the selected one does.

features.title: Pick up a task, with a drafted brief
features.copy: Turn an issue into a session with a brief in one pick.

features.title: Start one session from several issues
features.copy: Pick up to five issues for one session.

features.title: Review a pull request
features.copy: A pull request waiting on you in Tasks shows Review pull request in place of Start.

features.title: Run a workflow
features.copy: Write the goal, pick a preset and read the Plan you will run, with a model on every step.

features.title: Ask an agent
features.copy: Map an unfamiliar repo before you plan.

features.title: Start more work in a session
features.copy: New in a session opens a menu: Run a workflow, Orchestrate, Ask an agent, Start Auto, Write a report and Draw a wireframe.

features.title: Start blank
features.copy: Start from the goal instead.

features.title: Named by Goodboy
features.copy: Get a short title without writing one.

features.title: Star an issue from Link work
features.copy: Link work links a task to the session only.

features.title: Undo an unlink
features.copy: Unlinking a task from a session acts at once, with a 10-second Undo toast, and Cmd+Z works too.

features.title: Move an issue between the session and a branch
features.copy: Choose where an issue belongs with Move to in its chip menu: the session or one of the open branches of its project.

features.title: Session overview
features.copy: The Overview is titled with the session's name, its linked issue key in gray before it, and a single click renames it in place across the whole title row (Enter saves, Escape cancels).

features.title: Refresh a session
features.copy: Pull requests opened outside Goodboy, by an agent or from a terminal, show up when a turn ends or when you come back to the window.

features.title: Activity
features.copy: Follow what happened in a session in two views.

features.title: Next
features.copy: Know the moves that unblock the task, such as answering a question, fixing a failing check or opening a pull request.

features.title: Time left
features.copy: See how long a step has left, estimated from your own past runs.

features.title: File versions
features.copy: Undo an agent's edit in a session without a branch: each file it changed is kept as it was, with Restore.

features.title: Session list
features.copy: The left column lists the sessions of the workspace, one line each, with a sign that says whether an agent is working, you must act, or the task is done.

features.title: Pin a session to keep it at the top
features.copy: Keep the sessions you return to at the top of the list.

features.title: Now chip
features.copy: Know what needs you from any screen.

features.title: Notifications
features.copy: Catch up in one place.

features.title: Open in new window
features.copy: Give each workspace its own window, so switching does not interrupt running agents.

features.title: Sidebar
features.copy: Every place you go sits in one sidebar on the left: New session, then Sessions, Tasks, Chat and Terminal (each with a + to start one) and Workflows, then your pinned and recent sessions, and Settings.

features.title: Go anywhere
features.copy: Reach any screen without the mouse.

features.title: Command palette
features.copy: Press ⌘K to act on what you are looking at.

features.title: Search
features.copy: Find a message, a plan, a decision, an issue or a branch with ⌘F.

features.title: Right click menus
features.copy: Right click a session, agent, run, artifact, pull request, file or message to see every action it has.

features.title: Start a project from nothing
features.copy: Begin with an empty folder and no repository.

features.title: Workspace with several projects
features.copy: Keep your repos together as one workspace, and let one session work across several of them.

features.title: Starred projects, descriptions and base branch
features.copy: Point agents at the right repo without naming it.

features.title: Worktrees
features.copy: Let agents edit in parallel without touching your checkout.

features.title: Several branches per project
features.copy: Work on several branches of one repo in the same session, each in its own worktree.

features.title: Workspace switcher and Reconnect
features.copy: Jump between workspaces and projects from one search.

features.title: Repo status across projects
features.copy: See which repos have something to pull right next to the workspace switcher.

features.title: Locate moved projects
features.copy: If you moved your repos to a new folder, the workspace settings name the projects Goodboy cannot find.

features.title: Keep .goodboy out of git
features.copy: Keep Goodboy's own folder out of your commits with one click.

features.title: Branch names
features.copy: Choose how new session branches are named: a Branch prefix, with or without the task id, or a Custom template.

features.title: Monitoring
features.copy: See which ports are taken and by whom, in four groups: Pinned (ports you pin, with your own description), Run by Goodboy, From workspace and Listening on this Mac.

features.title: Copy settings from another workspace
features.copy: Set up a new workspace by copying another one.

features.title: Shape the history
features.copy: Clean up a branch by hand in the Commits section.

features.title: Safe edits
features.copy: Undo and Redo, also ⌘Z and ⌘⇧Z, restore edits while the Commits page stays open.

features.title: Conflicting edits
features.copy: A conflicting edit names the file and leaves the branch as it was.

features.title: Conflicts merged in a copy
features.copy: When a step stops on a conflict, the notice names the step and the file, and your branch is untouched.

features.title: Push with lease and restore
features.copy: Force push updates the online branch separately after a local edit.

features.title: Backups
features.copy: Under the graph, Previous versions N opens the older histories of the branch with when and why each was saved.

features.title: Suggest a message
features.copy: Get a commit message drafted for a reword.

features.title: Bring them into the plan
features.copy: If someone pushed after you applied, Goodboy lists their new commits and offers to add them to the plan and push again.

features.title: Rebase on main
features.copy: Rebase on the worktree status line (6 behind main) moves the branch onto the latest main and calls an agent only on a conflict; the Commits base row reads Based on main 9d4b1f7 and offers a rebase only onto another base.

features.title: After a pull request merges
features.copy: Decide what happens to a merged branch: Ask first, Delete on this Mac or Also on origin, per workspace or project, with 14 days to restore it.

groups.title: Review and resolve on the Branch page

features.title: Resolve
features.copy: Turn review comments into commits without writing the fixes yourself.

features.title: Bulk actions
features.copy: Handle many comments at once.

features.title: Review sources
features.copy: Read pull request comments and your own notes in one list in the Comments section.

features.title: Comment states
features.copy: See what each comment needs next.

features.title: Failed drafts
features.copy: When a fix fails, the comment says why in one sentence and links to the agent's transcript.

features.title: See what a resolve did
features.copy: Open a fix run from Activity or from a comment to see what the agent did.

features.title: Hints when a fix starts
features.copy: Tell the agent what to weigh before a fix starts.

features.title: Fixes already on the branch
features.copy: Goodboy checks origin before it pushes.

features.title: A fix that went missing
features.copy: If a fix commit is no longer on the branch, for example after a squash done elsewhere, the comment reads Fix went missing.

features.title: Close on GitHub
features.copy: Finish a review with Push N fixes in the Branch header.

features.title: Review replies in your voice
features.copy: Choose the tone of the replies the agent drafts: Terse, Friendly, Formal or Your replies, which learns from your last 20 review replies.

features.title: Fixes on a branch that moved
features.copy: Accept a fix even after the branch got new commits.

features.title: Squash and fold the resolve commits
features.copy: Tidy the fix commits before reviewers see them, in the Commits section.

features.title: Notes before a pull request
features.copy: Review your own diff before anyone else does.

features.title: Pull request on the Branch page
features.copy: Click a worktree under Projects in a session and the session rail steps into it: the project and the branch on top, a status line with Rebase while the branch is behind, then Pull request, Comments, Files (with the lines added and removed beside the file count), Commits and Checks with their counts.

features.title: One trail to the Branch page
features.copy: Every way into a branch, from the palette, a notification, a chat card or the board, opens the same Branch page with the session rail stepped into that branch.

features.title: Write it
features.copy: Get a pull request title, description and changelog entry in your repo's format, then Goodboy pushes the branch and opens the pull request.

features.title: PR description follows the push

features.title: Read the code
features.copy: Read the branch against its base in Files, unified or split.

features.title: Write review
features.copy: Review someone else's pull request from its diff.

features.title: Stage board
features.copy: See where each task stands without moving cards around.

features.title: List view
features.copy: Scan every session in one table.

features.title: Done and Archived lanes
features.copy: Finished work stays in view.

features.title: Session card
features.copy: Read a task at a glance: its title on two lines, its project in gray, and one signal at the right.

features.title: Bulk select
features.copy: Tidy many sessions at once.

features.title: Workflow builder
features.copy: Set up a run before it starts: a name, a goal and a mode, with the plan previewed as a recipe, step 1 on top.

features.title: Orchestrated
features.copy: Give a goal and let a model pick each next step, with its role, model, effort and a reason, until it reports done or blocked.

features.title: Preset and Custom

features.title: Built-in workflows

features.title: Saved steps

features.title: Model per step

features.title: Autonomy

features.title: Pause, resume and skip

features.title: Run defaults

features.title: Limit

features.title: Chained starts

features.title: Hints to the orchestrator

features.title: Why each step, and the run recap

features.title: Trackers

features.title: Code hosts

features.title: Checks
features.copy: Lists CI checks in one grid grouped Failing, Running, Passed and Skipped, each group label carrying its count (PrChecks, CheckRunRow), with no summary line. Analyze is the one verb on a failing row and asks the Debugger why it failed; once a Debugger exists the row opens its drawer and reads a short state (Analyzing, Fix proposed, Fixing, Not pushed, Re-running) through features/branch/components/AnalyzedCheckRow.tsx. Start fix and Push live in the Debugger drawer (pushCheckFix.ts), which leads with the outcome line (ciFixOutcomeOf.ts), then the steps (ciFixStepsOf.ts), Finding and Proposed fix, and one model line beside Start fix. Running reads in the info tone, a fix that waits on your push in warning. The Checks property, readiness, the activity row and the worktree entry read one word, checksWordOf (2 failing, 1 running, 5 passed) over pullRequestRunsOf
